result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial verification of Story 5 against the story, full Epic 5 tech design, and test plan, then against the prepare/build/runtime code paths (`prepareAsyncThread`, lower-band catch-up, `runSmartCompact`, `buildThreadViewProjection`, and materialization), the mapped service/command/E2E tests, and the configured `npm run verify` plus `npm run verify-all` gates.

newFindings.title: Story 5 lacks the required post-compact PI continuation proof
newFindings.evidence: Story 5 requires E2E proof that PI continues after smart compact consumes ready semantic lower-band output (story lines 19-28, 136-150, 175-184; test plan lines 399-414). The only Story 5 long-thread E2E in `tests/context-steward/long-thread-real-pi-execution.e2e.test.ts` performs two live PI turns before compaction (lines 658-703), runs `runSmartCompact` (lines 718-746), and ends after asserting generated output/reload state and generated-file contents (lines 762-824). There is no post-compact `runPiWithTools` continuation turn against the new generated rollout, so the required continuation proof is still missing even though `npm run verify-all` passes.

newFindings.title: Brief-band readiness and failure semantics are not directly proven
newFindings.evidence: The story maps both brief-band readiness/failure cases to `tests/thread/async-thread-run-service.test.ts` (story lines 128-138). But the Story 5 tests only remove `lowerBand.detailed` and assert detailed-specific warning/blocker behavior: catch-up success at `tests/thread/async-thread-run-service.test.ts:921-1008`, catch-up failure at `:1064-1117`, and command-path failure safety at `tests/commands/smart-compact.test.ts:871-980`. There is no corresponding test that removes `lowerBand.brief`, emits a brief-band catch-up warning, or asserts a brief-specific blocker/error, so `TC-4.1b` and `TC-4.3b` remain unproven from current evidence.

productionPathFindings: `src/workbench/services/workbench-query-service.ts:130-219` still exposes placeholder-era inspection semantics: it reports missing `placeholder` output and reads chunk detail summaries from `chunk.placeholders`, with tests still asserting `deterministic_placeholder_not_semantic` behavior in `tests/context-workbench/workbench-query-service.test.ts:850-870`. Formal inspection is out of Story 5 scope, but this remains a real-code placeholder inspection path.
additionalObservations: `npm run verify` passed with 486 service tests, including the real provider-backed detailed and brief lower-band tests.
`npm run verify-all` passed, including the long-thread real-PI smart-compact E2E, but gate success does not close the missing continuation proof or the missing brief-band Story 5 proof above.
